question: one of my clients changed jobs and now works at Bayside Plumbing. how do i put her under that business instead of her old one

articles.title: Link a contact to a company
articles.body:
A contact can belong to one company.

1. Go to **Contacts** and open the contact.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Choose the company in the **Company** list. Choose **No company** to unlink the contact.
4. Select **Save contact**.

The contact now appears under **Contacts at this company** on the company's page. If the company isn't in the list yet, add it first under **Companies**.

answer:
A contact can belong to one company, so you just switch her company:

1. Go to **Contacts** and open the contact.
2. Select **Edit**.
3. Choose Bayside Plumbing in the **Company** list.
4. Select **Save contact**.

She'll then appear under **Contacts at this company** on Bayside Plumbing's page. If Bayside Plumbing isn't in the list yet, add it first under **Companies**.
